```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow common) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileBlock 'Tile' ***/
    var tile = common.CreateBlock("Tile");
    tile.Description = null; // default value
    tile.Public = false; // default value
    var eSpace = common.GetESpace();
    
    var clicked = tile.CreateEvent("Clicked");
    clicked.IsMandatory = false;
    
    var onTileClick = tile.CreateScreenAction("OnTileClick");
    
    var startNode = onTileClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var formatDate = onTileClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("FormatDate");
    var formatDate2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("FormatDate");
    formatDate.Action = formatDate2;
    startNode.Target = formatDate;
    
    var endNode = onTileClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    formatDate.Target = endNode;
    
    var container = tile.CreateWidget<ServiceStudio.Plugin.NRWidgets.IContainer>();
    container.SetStyle("\"demo-tile\"");
    var event1 = container.CreateEvent();
    event1.Event = "onclick";
    event1.Handler = onTileClick;
}
```
